patch_description:
Builds on the current 3-fold symmetric multi-start (4 base points -> 12 rotated points + center). Key improvements per the recommendations:

1. **Hull-expansion move**: in the symmetric refine stage and polish stage, periodically try scaling all points outward by 1.01× (about the hull centroid). This reduces the hull-area denominator of the true score; it is accepted only when the true min_area/hull_area score strictly improves. Since expansion also increases min triangle area in absolute terms, this often gains score when points hug the hull boundary.

2. **Sharper guidance blend**: the internal hill-climb objective uses 0.8·min + 0.2·(mean of 3 smallest areas), a sharper approximation of the true min than the previous 0.6/0.4-over-5 blend. Final selection across seeds always uses the exact min/hull ratio, so the reported metric is never diluted by the blend.

3. Vectorized triangle-area evaluation with incremental updates for single-point moves keeps evaluation fast; overall runtime stays within a few seconds.
